en.text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你救我！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你救我！

en.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

zhSimplified.text: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地；

zhTraditional.text: 我陷在深淤泥中，沒有立腳之地；

en.text: I am weary with my crying. is dry. for my God.

zhSimplified.text: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干；

zhTraditional.text: 我因呼求困乏，喉嚨發乾；

en.text: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

zhSimplified.text: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多；

zhTraditional.text: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多；

en.text: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；

en.text: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 万军的主—耶和华啊， 的 神啊，

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍的主－耶和華啊， 的上帝啊，

en.text: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

zhSimplified.text: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂，

zhTraditional.text: 因我為你的緣故受了辱罵，

en.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

zhSimplified.text: 我的弟兄看我为外路人；

zhTraditional.text: 我的弟兄看我為外路人；

en.text: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

zhSimplified.text: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧，

zhTraditional.text: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒，

en.text: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

zhSimplified.text: 我哭泣，以禁食我心；

zhTraditional.text: 我哭泣，以禁食我心；

en.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

zhSimplified.text: 我拿麻布当衣裳，

zhTraditional.text: 我拿麻布當衣裳，

en.text: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

zhSimplified.text: 坐在城门口的谈论我；

zhTraditional.text: 坐在城門口的談論我；

en.text: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 但我在悦纳的时候向你—耶和华祈祷。

zhTraditional.text: 但我在悅納的時候向你－耶和華祈禱。

en.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

zhSimplified.text: 求你搭救我出离淤泥，

zhTraditional.text: 求你搭救我出離淤泥，

en.text: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. the pit shut its mouth on me.

zhSimplified.text: 求你不容大水漫过我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你不容大水漫過我，

en.text: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你應允我！

en.text: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

zhSimplified.text: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人；

zhTraditional.text: 不要掩面不顧你的僕人；

en.text: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. me because of my enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 求你亲近我，救赎我！

zhTraditional.text: 求你親近我，救贖我！

en.text: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

zhSimplified.text: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱；

zhTraditional.text: 你知道我受的辱罵、欺凌、羞辱；

en.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

zhSimplified.text: 辱骂伤破了我的心，

zhTraditional.text: 辱罵傷破了我的心，

en.text: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

zhSimplified.text: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物；

zhTraditional.text: 他們拿苦膽給我當食物；

en.text: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們的筵席在他們面前變為網羅，

en.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见；

zhTraditional.text: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；

en.text: Pour out your indignation on them. the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

zhSimplified.text: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上，

zhTraditional.text: 求你將你的惱恨倒在他們身上，

en.text: Let their habitation be desolate. no one dwell in their tents.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们的住处变为荒场；

zhTraditional.text: 願他們的住處變為荒場；

en.text: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，你所擊打的，他們就逼迫；

en.text: Charge them with crime upon crime. them come into your righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪，

zhTraditional.text: 願你在他們的罪上加罪，

en.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們從生命冊上被塗抹，

en.text: But I am in pain and distress. your salvation, God, protect me.

zhSimplified.text: 但我是困苦忧伤的；

zhTraditional.text: 但我是困苦憂傷的；

en.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

zhSimplified.text: 我要以诗歌赞美 神的名，

zhTraditional.text: 我要以詩歌讚美上帝的名，

en.text: It will please the LORD better than an ox, a bull that has horns and hoofs.

zhSimplified.text: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛，

zhTraditional.text: 這便叫耶和華喜悅，勝似獻牛，

en.text: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

zhSimplified.text: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐；

zhTraditional.text: 謙卑的人看見了就喜樂；

en.text: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人，

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華聽了窮乏人，

en.text: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

zhSimplified.text: 愿天和地、

zhTraditional.text: 願天和地、

en.text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

zhSimplified.text: 因为 神要拯救，建造的城邑；

zhTraditional.text: 因為上帝要拯救，建造的城邑；

en.text: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

zhSimplified.text: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业；

zhTraditional.text: 他僕人的後裔要承受為業；
